kind_why: A combat surf map: small, built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.

open_doors.name: jdoor
open_doors.note: The jail's door. The catch-all floor teleport (trigger_teleport aimed at `jailed`) puts every fallen player in a roofed cell whose only way out is this door, which the map's `jbutton` opens; the importer runs no outputs, so the door stayed shut and a player or bot that fell was stuck for good. Opened, a fall is a drop back into the fight. The keypad's secret_door is left shut: it is a puzzle, and its room has its own exits.

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones (gb-maps-1): a combat surf map with no finish -- two buyzones, a weapon room, a jail with a button door and a keypad secret room. Every trigger_teleport aims back at a spawn, a jail or the top of a ramp, so there is a loop to fight on and no line a run could end at. Not published.
